title: HGPRGDel: GPR-Aware Learning and Ranking for Growth-Coupled Gene Deletion Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.37478v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Designing microbial strains for growth-coupled production, in which cellular growth is linked to the synthesis of a target compound through genetic interventions, is a fundamental goal in metabolic engineering. Constraint-based methods can identify growth-coupled deletion strategies, but design for each target typically requires a separate search across a large number of possible gene-deletion combinations. This motivates a reusable approach that learns from previously evaluated strain designs to prioritize candidate interventions before downstream constraint-based evaluation. We present a reproducible protocol for growth-coupled gene deletion design that learns and ranks gene-deletion priorities for each target metabolite. translated_title: HGPRGDel：基于GPR感知的生长耦合基因敲除设计的学习与排序
translated_abstract: 通过基因干预将细胞生长与目标化合物的合成相关联的生长耦合生产菌株设计，是代谢工程中的一项基本目标。基于约束的方法可以识别生长耦合的基因敲除策略，但针对每个目标产物通常需要在大量可能的基因敲除组合中进行单独搜索。这促使人们寻求一种可复用的方法，即从先前评估过的菌株设计中学习，以便在下游基于约束的评估之前对候选基因干预进行优先级排序。我们提出了一种可复现的生长耦合基因敲除设计协议，该协议能够为每个目标代谢物学习并排序基因敲除优先级。利用计算整理的敲除策略作为学习资源，该协议可生成连续的敲除优先级排序，在可调节的搜索空间预算下构建候选策略，并进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出了HGPRGDel，一种GPR感知的可复现协议，通过从已有菌株设计数据中学习并生成基因敲除优先级排序，从而在基于约束的评估之前高效筛选候选干预方案，加速生长耦合微生物菌株的设计。
en_tdlr: HGPRGDel is a reproducible, GPR-aware protocol that learns from previously evaluated strain designs to rank gene deletion priorities, enabling efficient prioritization of candidate interventions and accelerating growth-coupled strain design for target metabolites.
